current_owner_admin_web_push_20261110.decision: Notify opted-in admitted administrators on iOS Home Screen when new email-verified signup approvals, pending/conflicting coffees or unfinished account deletions require action. Preserve in-app badges. Deliver generic, content-free Web Push without member identity, notes or shot data; administrator Auth revalidated for registration, live admin role rechecked for every scheduled delivery, no alerts for unverified signups. Offer device opt-out and remove stale subscriptions.
current_owner_admin_web_push_20261110.scope: Source-only Netlify scheduled sender, verified Admin subscription API, strict VAPID endpoint validation, service-only Supabase SQL table/aggregate, PWA worker/client, tests and queue; separate owner Publish and verified runtime secrets required for delivery.
current_owner_admin_web_push_20261110.supersedes: Only the previous absence of off-app delivery in #1756; preserves all signup approval, Auth, admin isolation, offline/Community, source-isolation and publication gates.
current_owner_admin_web_push_20261110.provider_limit: Netlify Free cannot protect Functions-only VAPID secrets. Owner Nov11 authorized fixing/publishing #1938 with all READY; this scope-preserving implementation keeps generic Netlify 5-minute cron plus Admin API, and places P-256 VAPID key encryption in Supabase Vault with signing inside role-rechecked service-only Supabase Edge. No VAPID/private service key in Netlify, GitHub or browser. Live Edge/migration/Apple device delivery must be verified before DEPLOYED.
